# SYNESIS_E123 — Warning

## Description

`RELATION` in several CHAIN fields; use FROM.

## Severity

This diagnostic is **local to an `EXPORT` block**. When compiling it is reported as a warning and the corpus still compiles; in `synesis export` it stops that block (that artifact is not written) and the other blocks run.

## Compiler message

```text
`EXPORT <FORMAT> <name>`: the relation `RELATION` exists in more than one CHAIN field ().
  Say which with `MAP RELATIONS RELATION FROM <field> TO ...`.
```

## Where it appears

Values the diagnostic carries (what the message names):

- **AmbiguousRelation**: `block`, `relation`, `fields`
